summary_en: This early phase study tests prophylactic heated intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) with mitomycin C to lower the risk of peritoneal recurrence in people with gallbladder adenocarcinoma who are at high risk of that recurrence. The drug is delivered into the abdomen during surgery: 30 mg of mitomycin C over the first 60 minutes, then 10 mg over an additional 30 minutes, with the fluid heated to a tissue temperature of 42°. The study measures feasibility, including intra-operative complications, technical challenges, 90-day morbidity and mortality, length of stay, and readmission.
summary_es: Este estudio en fase temprana evalúa la quimioterapia intraperitoneal calentada (HIPEC) preventiva con mitomicina C para reducir el riesgo de recurrencia peritoneal en personas con adenocarcinoma de vesícula biliar que tienen alto riesgo de esa recurrencia. El medicamento se administra dentro del abdomen durante la cirugía: 30 mg de mitomicina C durante los primeros 60 minutos, seguidos de 10 mg durante 30 minutos adicionales, con el líquido calentado a una temperatura tisular de 42°. El estudio mide la factibilidad, incluidas las complicaciones intraoperatorias, los desafíos técnicos, la morbilidad y mortalidad a 90 días, la duración de la estancia hospitalaria y los reingresos.
who_for: Confirmed gallbladder adenocarcinoma with bile spillage or intentional decompression during cholecystectomy, tumor through the gallbladder wall (T3/T4), or poor
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Blood counts, liver tests, and creatinine within the required limits
Eligible for standard central liver resection and portal lymphadenectomy
Able to understand and sign written informed consent
not_for: Prior systemic therapy for gallbladder adenocarcinoma
Receiving other investigational agents, or known or suspected metastatic disease
Allergic reactions to mitomycin C or similar compounds
Uncontrolled illness, or pregnancy or breastfeeding
History of hepatitis B or C, or cancer-related biliary obstruction including need for a biliary stent
